intent: Hold the sender's picture at the bottom of a message row, or reserve its width when left empty.
typical_uses: The sender's Avatar beside the message
An empty slot on the earlier messages of a MessageGroup, keeping their surfaces aligned

dont_use_when.situation: A person's picture anywhere outside a message row

invariants.text: The slot never shrinks, is at least var(--space-8) wide, centers its content and sits at the bottom of the row; left empty it still reserves that width.
When the row contains a MessageFooter, the slot is shifted up by var(--space-8) so it lines up with the message surface rather than with the footer below it.
The slot draws a round var(--muted) background but clips nothing, so an AvatarBadge overhanging the Avatar's circle stays visible.

anti_patterns.dont: Put the sender's name inside MessageAvatar
anti_patterns.do_instead: Put the name in a MessageHeader inside MessageContent and keep the slot for the picture

good.title: The sender's Avatar in the slot

bad.title: The sender's name placed in the avatar slot
bad.why: The slot is a round, muted, bottom-anchored cell sized for a picture; a name placed there sits beside the bubble on a pill background instead of above it in the muted header style.
